description:
This video explains how distance and adjacency work in kinematic space, a space where points represent intervals or geodesics from a bulk space. It covers how intervals are mapped to points, how causal order and Lorentzian geometry are applied, and how measures and distances are calculated using the Crofton form. The video also discusses the relationship between kinematic space and tensor networks like MERA, and how to avoid common errors when interpreting these networks.

Report sources:
https://arxiv.org/abs/1505.05515
https://arxiv.org/abs/1512.01548
https://arxiv.org/abs/1604.02687

title: Kinematic Space: Geometry of Intervals and Geodesics
